events.input: $ cd /tmp; B=https://revops-centre.growthcluborg.workers.dev; J=$(mktemp); curl -s -c $J -o /dev/null -H "Origin: $B" --data-urlencode "token=$(cat ~/.config/tantra/revops-admin-key)" $B/admin/enter; curl -s -b $J "$B/admin/api/delivery" | python3 -c "import json,sys;d=json.load(sys.stdin);o=d.pop('outputs');print(d);print(len(o),'outputs')"; echo $J
